newsitem.title: USA: Continental Can sees FY 97 EPS above $1.50.
newsitem.headline: Continental Can sees FY 97 EPS above $1.50.

text.p: Continental Can Co Inc president Donald Bainton said he is confident the company will earn in excess of $1.50 per share in 1997.
Speaking in a press release Bainton said acquisition of an additional 34 percent interest in Plastic Containers Inc comes at a time when its earnings are expected to improve substantially.

"Additionally, the completion of a three-year restructuring program at Ferembal, coupled with the 1996 restructuring program, at Plastic Containers, will result in increased manufacturing efficiencies in 1997. Based on this, I am confident that the Company will earn in excess of $1.50 per share in 1997," said Bainton.

Continental Can earlier reported an earnings per share loss of $1.69 per share for its 1996 year, after taking $1.87 per share in extraordinary charges. Before the extraordinary items, the company earned a profit of $0.18 in 1996.
